title: Closing a Service Account — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
An account holder may close their Service Accounts and Repair Orders service account.

**Conditions.**
- Where the tier requires it, an account is closed only when nothing is owed on it.
- An account is closed only from active status; an account on credit hold must first be reinstated. The status is read from the account record.

**Effects.**
- Where the tier forfeits points on closing, every unredeemed point is forfeited on the closing date by a points-expired entry; this applies to an account at an Owner Rewards tier that still holds points.
- The closing date is recorded on the account; the tier held at closing is unchanged by the closure.
- A closed account is not reopened; a later visit opens a new Service Guest Account.

| Account status | Amount owed | May it be closed? |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 0.00 | Yes |
| Active | Above 0.00 | No |
| Credit hold | Any | No — it must first be reinstated |
| Closed | — | Already closed; it is not reopened |

**Hypothetical.** A Kessler Owner Rewards Gold account holding 2740 points and owing nothing is closed; the 2740 points are forfeited on the closing date by one points-expired entry.
